"import json
import numpy as np
import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc


class Turbojet(om.Group):
    def setup(self):
        # cycle elements
        self.add_subsystem('fc', pyc.FlightConditions())
        self.add_subsystem('inlet', pyc.Inlet())
        self.add_subsystem('comp', pyc.Compressor())
        self.add_subsystem('burner', pyc.Combustor(thermo_data=pyc.AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC))
        self.add_subsystem('turb', pyc.Turbine())
        self.add_subsystem('noz', pyc.Nozzle())
        self.add_subsystem('shaft', pyc.Shaft(num_ports=1))

        # flow connections
        self.connect('fc.Fl_O', 'inlet.Fl_I')
        self.connect('inlet.Fl_O', 'comp.Fl_I')
        self.connect('comp.Fl_O', 'burner.Fl_I')
        self.connect('burner.Fl_O', 'turb.Fl_I')
        self.connect('turb.Fl_O', 'noz.Fl_I')

        # shaft connections
        self.connect('turb.shaft', 'shaft.shaft_in_0')
        self.connect('shaft.shaft_out_0', 'comp.shaft')

        # performance calculations
        self.add_subsystem('perf', om.ExecComp(
            ['Fn = Fg - F_ram',
             'Wfuel = Wout - Win',
             'TSFC = Wfuel * 3600.0 / Fn',
             'OPR = Pt3 / Pt2'],
            Fn={'units': 'lbf'}, Fg={'units': 'lbf'}, F_ram={'units': 'lbf'},
            Wfuel={'units': 'lbm/s'}, Wout={'units': 'lbm/s'}, Win={'units': 'lbm/s'},
            TSFC={'units': '1/hr'}, Pt3={'units': 'psi'}, Pt2={'units': 'psi'}))

        self.connect('noz.Fg', 'perf.Fg')
        self.connect('inlet.F_ram', 'perf.F_ram')
        self.connect('turb.Fl_O:tot:W', 'perf.Wout')
        self.connect('comp.Fl_I:tot:W', 'perf.Win')
        self.connect('comp.Fl_O:tot:P', 'perf.Pt3')
        self.connect('comp.Fl_I:tot:P', 'perf.Pt2')

        # balances:
        #   W (engine airflow) driven to hit Fn target
        #   turb.PR driven to null net shaft power
        bal = om.BalanceComp()
        bal.add_balance('W', lhs_name='Fn', rhs_name='Fn_target')
        bal.add_balance('PR', lhs_name='shpwr', rhs_name='shpwr_target')
        self.add_subsystem('bal', bal)

        self.connect('perf.Fn', 'bal.Fn')
        self.connect('shaft.shpwr', 'bal.shpwr')
        self.connect('bal.W', 'fc.W')
        self.connect('bal.PR', 'turb.PR')

        # solvers
        newton = self.nonlinear_solver = om.NewtonSolver(solve_subsystems=False)
        newton.options['maxiter'] = 100
        newton.options['atol'] = 1e-7
        newton.options['rtol'] = 1e-10
        newton.options['iprint'] = 0
        newton.linesearch = om.BoundsEnforceLS(bound_enforcement='vector')
        newton.linesearch.options['iprint'] = -1
        self.linear_solver = om.DirectSolver()


def main():
    p = om.Problem(model=Turbojet())
    p.setup(force_alloc_complex=False)
    om.n2(p, outfile='n2.html', show_browser=False) if False else None

    # design point settings: SL static
    p.set_val('fc.alt', 0.0, units='ft')
    p.set_val('fc.MN', 0.001)
    p.set_val('inlet.ram_recovery', 1.0)

    p.set_val('comp.PR', 14.5)
    p.set_val('comp.eff', 0.90)
    p.set_val('burner.Tt4', 2750.0, units='degR')
    p.set_val('burner.dPqP', 0.03)
    p.set_val('turb.eff', 0.90)

    # balance targets and guesses
    p.set_val('bal.Fn_target', 10500.0)      # lbf
    p.set_val('bal.shpwr_target', 0.0)      # net shaft power = 0
    p.set_val('bal.W', 140.0)               # lbm/s guess
    p.set_val('bal.PR', 0.30)               # turbine PR guess

    p.run_model()

    Fn = float(p.get_val('perf.Fn', units='lbf')[0])

    print('Wfuel   =', Wfuel, 'lbm/s')
    print('Wair    =', Wair, 'lbm/s')
    print('T4      =', p.get_val('burner.Fl_O:tot:T', units='degR')[0])
